description: NVIDIA's offline speech-to-text model on one DGX Spark: 40-language transcription, speaker tags and word timestamps for recordings up to an hour, served by vLLM 0.32.0 with NeMo Speech as the model card prescribes. Send audio to /v1/chat/completions as an audio_url; it is not a /v1/audio/transcriptions route. Memory is converted from the creator's 0.85 of a 96 GB RTX PRO 6000 and is an estimate until tried.
title: Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe 30B-A4B NVFP4 (NVIDIA, vLLM, single Spark)
